subject: P20 built after the P19 reset: staged probes s0/s1/s2 + full, announce+flush before every access
body:
P20 BUILT (host-only, NOT run, NOT flashed; needs the user's approval). Analysis in README-0107-design.md section 15; patch 0118-dvfs-announce-flush-stages-two-rail-reads.patch 1722d32d805dc9ac. Kernel p20a (series 0085..0118) sha256 e47b905be1a5d9382b00a6cf2d2074998a80bad4da4db6925540f3d776de5d4c; images in gpu/build/device-mmu-p20-candidate/:
- ui654fb60dvfs   b6879f8160b628f24b596f7198e3e99473a2c89e7bbc1fe06d7ea380a9344e9a  (607 chars, n2fbhz=60 n2dvfs=2000)
- ui654fb60       15c662930fe13150c202abba364b4643555bf9b0395787c7f8669353e41bc261  (fallback, no DVFS)
- probe350dvfs    90e218481bff33697bfce0f9d6a4725bc7cad0252a6a1ec612c1a006f7cdfd8d  (n2dvfs=1, full hand-over)
- probe350dvfs-s0 21f1ffdd092fda667b57b4847f147efc0eb6efd39b975d82b4995210996bea63  (n2dvfs=1 n2dvst=0: preflight only: clocks + 4 PMIC reads, nothing mapped/sent/stored)
- probe350dvfs-s1 dd2a09e6595f1b35e021e087e64faf35c43b220ca607b505fa66e9b2f523dfc0  (n2dvst=1: + share buffer)
- probe350dvfs-s2 29b375f7776806d0e038b484e004eb2b1a623c691de62af4ef6cbc95013548a1  (n2dvst=2: + platform init)
Suggested device order: s0, s1, s2, then probe350dvfs: each boot adds one class of access and the last log line names it.
ANALYSIS (host-only, cannot be proven): (1) The log is HOST-PULLED (control request 0x54, nord2-usb-console.py sleeps 0.25 s when idle) and the kernel has no flush: the last 0.25-0.5 s before a hard reset are never fetched, so 'no preflight line' does not mean the preflight did not run. The c6u log ends mid-line (JOBS line cut at 'seqw=92/'). (2) The USB console loop on CPU0 is the ONLY kicker of the hardware watchdog (wdt[2]=0x1971 per iteration, WDT length 0xf000 = 30 s): if CPU0 stops running it (e.g. panic after a bus error), the log ends at once and the SoC resets within 30 s. (3) 0117 added NO register access that P18 had not done: B and CCI rails are the SAME registers as L and LL (Vproc1/Vsram1 = SID6 VBUCK1 0x1499 + MT6359P 0x1e90; Vproc2/Vsram2 = SID7 VBUCK3 0x1599 + 0x1eb0); P19 only repeated them (8 owner reads instead of 4: more time with the GPU lock held, no reset path). (4) What ONLY P19 reached (rails passed): the share buffer (first ml_io_map of 2 MiB at 0x70000000 + 524288 device stores), the platform doorbell, the first CSRAM stores, the DVFS messages. Most likely culprit: the share buffer; then the CSRAM stores.
FIX 0118: only the proven LL and L rail pairs are read (4 PMIC reads, B and CCI derived by the stock sharing rule and printed as such; cmd 10 reuses these values, no PMIC read after the first message); EVERY hardware access is announced with a 'NORD2 DVFS access N: next is ...' line followed by a 400 ms flush wait (longer than the host pull period), so after a hard reset the last line names the access; share buffer = stock behaviour (header + end mark, only the first and last 16 KiB mapped, no 2 MiB zero fill); stage limit n2dvst=0..3. Tests: exactly 2 rail reads before any message, B/CCI never read, each stage sends nothing beyond its stage, every rail/share/mailbox/store-group preceded by a flush (10 mutations killed). run_all.sh gate on the P20 stage is queued behind other agents' gates and will be reported.
